title: Marketplace polish — buttons, phone chips, install errors

steps.headline: A filled button standing alone is now 2 pixels taller, the same height as an outlined button.
steps.changed: Every filled (and red) button in the app got an invisible 1-pixel edge, so it is exactly as tall as an outlined one.
steps.notice: Start session is 2px taller here; on its own you will barely see it — it matters where two buttons sit side by side.
steps.risk: Every filled button in the app grows by 2px; a very tight row could now wrap a line sooner.

steps.path: Close a session → the close prompt
steps.headline: The close prompt's filled button grows 2 pixels, like every filled button.
steps.changed: Same change: an invisible edge on filled buttons.
steps.notice: Close session sits 2px taller at the bottom of the prompt.

steps.path: Settings → turn on Skip permissions (first time)
steps.headline: Cancel and Turn it on now line up exactly — before, the filled one was 2 pixels shorter than its outlined neighbour.
steps.changed: The filled button gained the invisible edge the outlined one always had.
steps.notice: The two buttons' tops and bottoms are level.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & sync → remove a backup
steps.headline: Red confirm buttons get the same edge: Remove and Cancel are now the same height.
steps.changed: The red (filled) button gained the invisible edge, like the other filled buttons.

steps.path: Marketplace → Connect your stuff → Google Workspace
steps.headline: Uninstall and Connect still line up — now from the shared button, not a fix on this page alone.
steps.changed: The detail pages' own workaround is removed; the shared button does it everywhere.
steps.notice: Nothing changes on this page; it is here to show the pair still matches.

steps.path: Marketplace on a phone (390 wide), the card list
steps.headline: On phone-width Marketplace cards the shield chip is now as tall as the author chip beside it.
steps.changed: The shield chip shows only its icon on a phone, so it was 18px beside 22.5px chips. It now uses the shared chip, which keeps the text line's height.
steps.notice: The two chips under each card's description are level.

steps.path: Marketplace → Browser Use → Install fails, 8 seconds later
steps.headline: When an install fails, the reason now stays on the page until you retry, dismiss it or close the page.
steps.changed: Before, the red notice vanished after 6 seconds and left a plain Install button. Picture taken 8 seconds after the failure.
steps.notice: The bottom strip's copy of the message has a Dismiss button; trying again or closing the page also puts it away.
